nodes.title: 00 · Ember Route | Game Design Document
nodes.description: Main design: theme, Heat and Vent, 24 cards, map, enemies, relics, UI specifications, and first-release acceptance. Design preceded artwork generation on this canvas.

data.text:
Ember Route: Original 2D dark industrial fairytale, etched linework, and hand-painted cut-paper silhouettes. Ink teal #172427 / Cold iron #25383A / Aged copper #B98249 / Mint fire #78D6B6 / Rust red #D66A50 / Bone white #E8DCC0.
The hero is a lantern blacksmith with a dark teal cloak, copper half mask, short forge hammer, and square mint-flame furnace lantern. Hero faces right; enemies face left.
Artwork is divided into UI mockups and concept assets, not runnable prototypes. Final game text is typeset by the UI. Character images require extraction, sheets require slicing, and animation is separate work.
Generation order: Hero and background → Combat mockup and enemies/illustrations/icons → Map, reward, and mobile mockups. Use generated nodes as image references; the canvas displays derived dependency lines automatically.

nodes.title: Shared Art Direction and Asset Guidelines
nodes.description: Common visual direction for all artwork and constraints for subsequent asset production.

data.prompt: Create one original full-body 2D hand-painted game character concept for EMBER ROUTE, a dark industrial fairytale roguelike deckbuilder. A compact androgynous adult lantern blacksmith wearing a deep petrol-teal short cloak, charcoal leather workwear, heavy boots, bronze half face mask with one visible calm amber eye, short tousled dark hair. One hand holds a short forge hammer, the other holds a square antique copper furnace lantern containing pale mint-green flame, thick leather gloves, small pressure valve and brass tube on belt. Side three-quarter battle view, facing RIGHT. Readable strong silhouette, grounded slightly crouched idle pose, lantern and hammer clearly separated from body, entire body and all props inside image with 12 percent padding. Etched ink outlines, painterly color blocks, tactile copper and cloth, sophisticated illustrated 2D game art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Palette ink teal #172427, copper #B98249, mint #78D6B6, parchment #E8DCC0, very restrained rust red. Plain uniform light warm ivory background for easy extraction, NO landscape, NO ground plane, NO cast shadow, NO text, NO labels, NO border, NO extra characters. This is a usable isolated concept, not a poster. Original identity, no characters or symbols from existing games.

nodes.title: 01 · Hero Concept | Lan, the Lantern Blacksmith
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed: 1145×1374 full-body hero, complete copper mask, teal cloak, hammer, and furnace lantern. File has Alpha; transparent edges and a consistent foot anchor require checks.

data.prompt: A polished 16:9 widescreen 2D side-on battle background for an original dark industrial fairytale card game EMBER ROUTE. An ancient copper and iron bridge suspended above clouds, ruined foundry harbor of a floating city at dusk. Foreground a continuous flat dark iron walkway across the lower 62 percent height line, engraved rivets and faded copper plating. Far background floating factory silhouettes, colossal clocktower, hanging chains, thin mint-green furnace lights, muted sea-green fog. Framing left with one broken copper column and right with a damaged foundry arch, but keep central 75 percent of the arena broad, uncluttered and low contrast for combat characters. Reserve lower 28 percent as dark low-detail shadow gradient for a future hand of cards, upper 10 percent calm for HUD. Side-view orthographic stage, no steep perspective, no isometric floor. Hand-painted etched ink and cut-paper shapes, atmospheric depth, old copper #B98249, dark petrol teal #172427, desaturated cold iron #25383A, mint #78D6B6 as sparse accents. Rich art direction but gameplay readable. NO characters, NO monsters, NO user interface, NO cards, NO text, NO logo, NO border. Original scene, suitable game background rather than a busy fantasy poster.

nodes.title: 02 · Battle Environment | Ash Harbor Foundry Bridge

data.prompt: Design a finished in-game 16:9 screenshot mockup of EMBER ROUTE, an ORIGINAL turn-based roguelike deckbuilding browser game. Use the referenced lantern blacksmith identity and ruined copper bridge art direction consistently. This is an actual gameplay UI composition, not a marketing poster. Thick etched ink silhouettes and hand-painted industrial fairytale textures, dark ink teal, old copper, mint furnace flame, warm parchment. Top 8 percent: compact unobtrusive HUD with heart 52/68, copper coin 110, ACT I, three small relic icons, a settings gear. Middle 57 percent: reference hero on left facing right, square mint furnace lantern, short forge hammer; right two enemies facing left, one rusty masked copper blade sentinel and one small soot quadruped with glowing furnace mouth. Small clear health bars under characters; floating intention badges above enemies show a sword with 12 and a shield with 6, not speech bubbles. Bottom 30 percent: FIVE large upright playable cards with individual copper frames, parchment rules panels, round cost gems: STRIKE cost1, GUARD cost1, KINDLE cost0, FORGE cost1, COOL cost0. Card art is integrated in upper half with hammer slash, copper shield, lantern flame, forge hammer, and steam valve. No giant explanatory text. Left bottom energy roundel clearly 2/3, deck pile 12. Right bottom six-segment horizontal HEAT gauge clearly four mint segments and two dark segments, 4/6, a separate visible VENT button, and copper END TURN button. Discard pile 3. Keep readable, deliberate hierarchy, clean baseline, generous card text space. All UI must stay entirely inside frame with safe margins. Use short ENGLISH labels and simple numerals for legibility; do not render paragraphs or fake Chinese text. Match hero silhouette and environment reference. Copper borders restrained and functional, no dashboard panels covering combat, no franchise logos.

nodes.title: 03 · Combat UI Mockup | Heat and Vent
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed: 1672×941, with five cards, enemy intents, Energy, six-cell Heat, and Vent. Guard, Kindle, Forge Hammer, and enemy values are illustrative; use main document sections 5/7 for actual values.

data.prompt: Create a polished 16:9 game-screen visual prototype for the route map of EMBER ROUTE, an original dark industrial fairytale deckbuilder. Match the referenced combat screenshot palette and copper UI detailing but this screen is a navigable route chart, no battlefield or hand of cards. A worn dark teal nautical map laid over a faint floating foundry city silhouette, hand-etched copper dotted bridge connections. Center-left 70 percent contains a clear BOTTOM-TO-TOP branching journey in twelve horizontal rows, 1 to 3 generously separated circular icons per row. Bottom single small lantern start, top a LARGE bronze clock-bell boss node, penultimate row campsite. Icons: crossed hammers for battle, skull for elite, small furnace for rest, scales for shop, question mark for event, copper chest for treasure. Path already traveled is a warm copper solid line in bottom three rows, next reachable nodes have strong mint rings; unexplored nodes muted ivory outlines. Connections are sparse and readable with no tangled spaghetti. Right 22 percent narrow parchment legend with only six symbol-label pairs BATTLE, ELITE, REST, SHOP, EVENT, CHEST, and compact current section label ASH HARBOR. Top thin HUD heart52/68 coin110 deck14, relic icons. Bottom small VIEW DECK button and tooltip area, no long lore blocks. Hand-painted etched illustration, ink teal #172427, copper #B98249, mint #78D6B6, parchment #E8DCC0. Intentional polished game UX with real comfortable touch targets. Use short English labels, no fake text, no logos, no marketing title covering the map. Visual route concept rather than a mathematical graph specification.

nodes.title: 04 · Route Map Mockup | Twelve-Floor Ash Harbor Route
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed: 1672×941 twelve-floor route and node legend. Same-floor links, floor-6 nodes, and departure numbering are illustrative; follow the document's map-generation rules.

data.prompt: A polished 16:9 in-game card reward screen mockup for EMBER ROUTE, an original dark industrial fairytale deckbuilding game. Consistent copper frames, etched ink illustration, deep teal and mint highlights matching the reference combat UI. Background the reference foggy foundry bridge, subdued and darkened. Small top centered heading CHOOSE A CARD and subheading ONE FOR THE JOURNEY, compact top HUD heart52/68 coin135. Center THREE large equal-sized upright cards with comfortable wide spacing and readable parchment lower panels. Left card EMBER STRIKE cost1, bronze hammer and mint flame illustration, attack icon, short text Deal 8 damage / Heat +1. Middle card COPPER WALL cost1, ornate copper shield illustration, skill icon, short text Gain 8 Block / Heat +1, selected with thin mint outline and small tick below. Right card COOLDOWN cost0, spinning steam valve illustration, skill icon, short text Heat -2 / Gain 3 Block. Labels and simple numerals in clear English, intentional neat typography not gibberish paragraphs. Bottom center a strong copper TAKE CARD confirmation button, smaller clearly visible SKIP button next to it, VIEW DECK at bottom left. All content inside safe margins. Large tactile cards occupying about half screen height. Artwork rich but interface clean, no huge narrative panels, no character covering cards, no extra cards, no logos. Visual prototype not advertisement.

nodes.title: 05 · Reward UI Mockup | Choose One of Three or Skip

data.prompt: Create a clean TWO BY TWO grid of FOUR original isolated full-body 2D enemy game concepts for EMBER ROUTE, consistent with referenced hero and copper bridge visual identity. Plain solid light warm ivory background, NO text, NO labels, NO drawn grid lines, NO scenery, NO shadows. Each enemy entirely inside its separate equal quadrant with 15 percent margin, consistent side three-quarter view facing LEFT and grounded battle idle. TOP LEFT: RUSTBLADE SENTINEL, slim humanoid empty copper armor, iron mask, one rusty saber, tattered dark teal tabard, small mint eye slit. TOP RIGHT: SOOT WHELP, compact black soot quadruped furnace creature, oversized copper jaw plate with tiny mint-green fire mouth, smoky fur represented as clear painterly shape, four readable legs. BOTTOM LEFT: ROGUE LANTERN, a floating antique square copper cage lantern, mint furnace flame inside, two bent mechanical claw arms, short broken chains, bold simple silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT: IRON BELL OVERSEER boss, squat enormous bell-shaped copper iron armored torso on two heavy legs, hanging chain, massive forge hammer, central mint furnace mouth and clock markings, visibly heavier and more imposing than sentinel but still fully contained in quadrant. Beautiful etched ink outlines, copper #B98249, ink teal #172427, mint #78D6B6, rust #D66A50, matte hand-painted cut-paper fantasy art, not pixel art or 3D. No duplicated creature, no clipped weapons or limbs, no generic demon horns. Designed as source concepts to extract individually, not a poster.

data.prompt: A SIX-IMAGE concept illustration sheet for an original dark industrial fairytale card game EMBER ROUTE. EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows of equally sized separate square-like artwork tiles, thin consistent dark teal gutters. NO card frames, NO UI, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO cost symbols. Match the referenced copper masked lantern blacksmith costume, forge hammer, square mint flame lantern and sophisticated etched ink painterly style. TOP LEFT FORGE HAMMER: close-up leather-gloved hand swinging a short copper hammer with a mint fire arc, diagonal strong composition. TOP MIDDLE GUARD: riveted rounded copper shield resisting orange sparks, solid readable shape. TOP RIGHT KINDLE: gloved hand placing a luminous mint ember into a square copper furnace lantern. BOTTOM LEFT OVERHEAT SLASH: copper forge hammer smashing downward through a violent mint flame burst with restrained rust orange edges. BOTTOM MIDDLE CONDENSATION: turning antique brass pressure valve emitting soft pale mint-white cooling steam, clear circular silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT MEMORY SIGIL: floating etched copper square seal surrounded by three small ghostlike mint flame hammer echoes. Each tile is an independent dramatic card illustration with single focal subject, readable at thumbnail size. Deep petrol ink background #172427, copper #B98249, mint #78D6B6, muted ivory, rich brush texture and etched linework. Balanced negative space at edges, no unrelated faces, no montage overlap across tiles. Original artwork, no existing game assets.

data.prompt: Create EXACTLY EIGHT separate premium hand-painted 2D fantasy game item icons in a FOUR-column TWO-row grid, no drawn grid lines, each centered in its equally sized cell on a perfectly uniform light warm ivory background. EMBER ROUTE dark industrial fairytale, visual family of antique copper, petrol teal cloth, mint-green flame, thick elegant etched dark outlines. TOP ROW left to right: 1 square antique copper furnace core with small mint flame window, 2 cracked mint ember crystal held by dark copper prongs, 3 chunky bronze ring with mint teardrop gem, 4 folded dark leather blacksmith apron with copper rivets. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5 antique bronze impeller gear with five broad blades, 6 thick hollow copper coin with a square central hole, 7 worn copper compass with mint needle and soot mark, 8 a pair of insulated dark leather gloves with copper wire cuffs. NO text, NO numbers, NO labels, NO frames, NO landscape, NO cast shadows, NO hands holding items. All eight entire objects inside their cells with at least 20 percent spacing, distinct silhouette, simple geometry readable at 64 pixels. Subtle highlights, matte brush texture, consistent scale and lighting, not photorealistic and not 3D. Do not add extra icons or duplicate items. Concept source for later slicing and extraction.

data.prompt: Design a polished PORTRAIT 9:16 mobile game screenshot prototype of EMBER ROUTE, matching the referenced desktop combat screenshot and referenced hero. Original dark industrial fairytale turn-based deckbuilder, copper, dark petrol teal, mint fire, etched ink hand-painted art. NO phone hardware, NO perspective device frame, fill image edge to edge with the game screen. Top 9 percent compact HUD with heart52/68 coin110 and three small relic icons, settings. Upper middle 37 percent side-view copper bridge battlefield: small lantern blacksmith facing right at left, rusty copper sentinel and soot whelp facing left at right; readable intention icons 12 and 6 above enemies and small health bars below. Below arena compact energy roundel 2/3 and six-segment heat display 4/6 with four mint cells. Lower middle 34 percent a horizontal scrollable hand of cards, THREE main upright cards visible plus partial fourth at right, sufficiently large parchment rule panels: FORGE cost1, GUARD cost1, COOL cost0. Selected FORGE raised slightly and marked with mint edge, short readable text Deal 8 / High heat +5. Bottom 15 percent fixed safe-area control strip, three distinct large comfortable buttons VENT, PLAY, END TURN, with deck and discard small badges at edges. Sparse short English labels, simple numerals, no long text. Every element fits narrow portrait composition without overlapping, clear fingersize buttons and strong hierarchy. Rich atmosphere but no large explanatory panels, no desktop screen squeezed into portrait, no brand logos.

nodes.title: 09 · Mobile Combat Mockup | Portrait Touch Layout

data.text:
Design-stage delivery complete: 1 main design document, 4 UI mockups (desktop combat/route/reward/mobile combat), and 5 concept sets (hero/background/4 enemies/6 illustrations/8 relics).
Actual files were reviewed in that stage. Copper metal, ink-teal workwear, and mint firelight were consistent; intents, hand, Energy, Heat, and Vent were visible.
Implementation source: Actual rules in main document sections 4/5/7. Guard, Kindle, Forge Hammer, enemy values, same-floor map links, and floor-6 nodes have illustrative discrepancies. Do not extract rules from images. English labels were layout references; the original plan called for Chinese UI, later superseded by English localization.
Asset processing: Hero/enemy files have Alpha, but edges were not accepted pixel by pixel. Enemy/card/relic sheets require slicing, relic backgrounds require removal, and hero anchors/scales need normalization.
Original design-stage plan: Build a playable slice of Starting deck → Vent/Overheat → Single-enemy battle → Reward → Map before full-chapter content. That stage had artwork only. Chapter I is now playable, generated HUD assets are integrated, and real-input checks were performed. See node 15, Chapter I Implementation and Verification, for current scope and limits.

nodes.title: 10 · Initial Artwork Review (Design-Stage Record)
nodes.description: Results and usage limits after reviewing 9 images individually; full index in main document section 13.

data.text:
Keep existing rules. Persistent HUD: HP, gold, deck, relics, intents, Energy, Heat, and necessary actions only. Remove duplicate scene titles, the hero's duplicate health bar, persistent tutorials, text lists of powers, and irrelevant confirmation buttons. Use icons plus numbers for status; show detailed effects on hover or click.
New generated art: 16 copper/iron and mint HUD icons, one text-free card frame, and three text-free button plates. Slice, check transparency, convert to WebP, and integrate into public/art. Dynamic text and numbers remain programmatically typeset; this iteration originally used Chinese, later superseded by English.
Reduce the map legend to icons and short names. Generated icons replace persistent Unicode decorations. Keep Vent and End Turn visible in combat, showing Play confirmation only when needed. Preserve touch targets and accessible keyboard names.

nodes.title: 11 · HUD Iteration | Restrained Layout and Generated Assets
nodes.description: User direction: A small set of icons and values, details on demand, and generated art for richer material texture.

data.prompt: Production-ready 2D GAME HUD ICON ATLAS for EMBER ROUTE. EXACTLY SIXTEEN individual icons in an exact FOUR-COLUMN FOUR-ROW grid with EQUAL 256x256-style square cells. Every icon centered and fully contained within its cell with 22 percent blank padding. Plain solid pure WHITE background across the entire sheet, no scenery, no gradients behind objects, no contact shadows, no frame around sheet, no lettering, no labels, no numbers. Antique copper metal, dark petrol-teal recesses, subtle mint-green glow, detailed tactile metal patina and etched edges matching the reference blacksmith and card UI. Sparse clean readable silhouettes, front-facing orthographic small game icons, not bulky decorative badges. TOP ROW from left to right: a compact rust-red enamel HEART; a round COPPER COIN with square hole; a small MINT FLAME energy ember; a short COPPER THERMOMETER containing mint light. SECOND ROW left to right: a COPPER SHIELD; one diagonal SHORT COPPER SWORD; a tidy STACK OF THREE CARDS; a small COPPER PRESSURE VALVE releasing one mint steam curl. THIRD ROW left to right: a COPPER SETTINGS GEAR; a SIMPLE RIGHT-POINTING COPPER ARROW; a SHORT FORGE HAMMER; a small closed COPPER CHEST. FOURTH ROW left to right: an antique COPPER SKULL elite symbol; a small ROUND CAMP BRAZIER with mint flame; a small COPPER QUESTION MARK; a COPPER BELL. Exactly 16 objects, one per cell, consistent visual scale, none crossing cells. White background is essential for extraction. Do not add text, do not include UI screenshot, do not merge icons into an illustration. Refined illustrated game material texture, readable at 28 pixels, restrained highlights, no extra ornamental borders.

nodes.title: 12 · HUD Assets | Sixteen Copper-Furnace Icons
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed 1254×1254 transparent icon sheet; sliced into sixteen 128×128 WebP icons and integrated into resources, intents, statuses, piles, actions, and map.

data.prompt: One isolated FRONT-FACING EMPTY GAME CARD FRAME for an original dark industrial fantasy deckbuilder EMBER ROUTE. Portrait TWO TO THREE aspect ratio. Only ONE card, straight-on orthographic, no tilt, no perspective. Entire card in frame with 5 percent plain PURE WHITE outer background margin, no shadows outside card. Thin refined old copper and dark iron perimeter, slight chipped patina, tiny rivets at four corners, elegantly machined beveled edge, restrained etched detailing. NOT baroque, not bulky, avoid skull decorations. The top 43 percent of the card is one large empty plain DARK PETROL TEAL rectangular illustration window, uniformly colored so actual art can be layered later. Below it a slim EMPTY warm ivory card-name strip occupying 11 percent height. Lower 42 percent is one quiet pale ivory parchment rules area with a very subtle paper grain and generous negative space, fully blank. Small clean copper separators between the illustration, name and rules. No cost orb, no emblem inside the art window, no symbols in rules area. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS anywhere. Match the referenced copper/mint industrial hand-painted game aesthetic; functional high-end game UI production component with tactile materials, readable and calm, not a decorative card back. Distinctively thin copper frame and clean uncluttered blank parchment suitable for overlaying Chinese text in code. Do not include multiple cards or a mockup scene.

nodes.title: 13 · HUD Assets | Text-Free Aged Copper Card Frame
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed 1024×1536 text-free frame; outer background/chamfers cropped and resized to 512 pixels wide. Used in hand, rewards, shop, and deck; DOM overlays text and numbers (originally Chinese, now English).

data.prompt: Production 2D fantasy game UI asset sheet for EMBER ROUTE. EXACTLY THREE isolated HORIZONTAL RECTANGULAR BUTTON PLATES arranged in THREE EQUAL ROWS, one centered plate per row. Wide landscape THREE TO TWO overall canvas. Perfectly flat orthographic front-facing, no perspective, no tilt, no labels, no text, no numbers, no icons. Pure solid WHITE background everywhere outside the three plates, absolutely no background gradient, no scenery, no cast shadows. Each plate occupies 85 percent canvas width and only 65 percent of its row height with generous white separation. Each is a clean elongated horizontal button about 6 to 1 aspect ratio, softly clipped/chamfered four corners, thin refined antique copper border and tiny corner rivets. TOP ROW primary button: muted warm COPPER inset surface, subtle worn metal texture, softly beveled edge, nearly flat center left blank for UI text. MIDDLE ROW secondary button: deep DARK PETROL IRON inset surface, thin old copper outline, matte calm center. BOTTOM ROW selected button: deep TEAL inset surface, restrained pale MINT edge glow and copper corner caps, calm blank center. Sophisticated tactile etched hand-painted industrial fairytale textures, same visual family as referenced combat UI but LESS ornamental and with cleaner thin edges. No extra standalone circles, no decorative scrollwork, no embossed symbols, no panel titles. Exactly three empty buttons, fully separate and centered. Suitable for slicing as game CSS background images while rendering live labels above.

nodes.title: 14 · HUD Assets | Text-Free Button Plates
nodes.description: Generated and reviewed 1536×1024 three-row text-free button sheet; chamfers cropped and three 768-pixel-wide WebP plates exported for primary, secondary, and confirmation buttons.

data.prompt: Create a premium landscape 16:9 illustrated game cover for EMBER ROUTE, an original dark industrial fairytale roguelike deckbuilder. This is promotional key art, NOT a gameplay screenshot. Match the two reference images for the hero's precise identity and the floating copper foundry city. Composition: right 45 percent features a powerful three-quarter waist-up lantern blacksmith, androgynous adult, tousled short dark hair, one amber eye, worn bronze half face mask, deep petrol-teal cloak, heavy charcoal leather workwear, leather gloves. The blacksmith raises an antique SQUARE copper furnace lantern glowing with mint-green fire, carries a short forge hammer low on the other side. Crisp etched ink silhouette, rich painterly copper patina and cloth texture, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D. Background: ruined floating industrial city at dusk, suspended iron bridges leading through clouds towards an enormous distant clocktower, hanging chains and sparse mint furnace windows. A subtle branching copper route sweeps from bottom left towards the clocktower; a few floating ember specks. Left 50 percent is dark uncluttered atmospheric negative space for a large beautiful custom typographic title. Render EXACTLY the English title 'EMBER ROUTE', correctly spelled, in TWO stacked lines, EMBER above ROUTE, bold elegant sharply cut antique serif lettering, warm ivory and aged copper, restrained engraved metal texture, clean excellent readability at thumbnail size. Title stays wholly inside 8 percent safe margins and does not cross the hero. Below the title render a small restrained uppercase subtitle exactly 'A ROGUELIKE DECKBUILDER'. No other text, no Chinese, no badges, no buttons, no HUD, no card numbers, no franchise logos, no border, no watermark. Palette dark petrol #172427, cold iron #25383A, aged copper #B98249, mint flame #78D6B6, ivory #E8DCC0. Dramatic controlled lantern rim lighting, layered atmospheric depth, original sophisticated hand-painted etched fantasy game box art, coherent with the references, strong readable thumbnail hierarchy.
